statement.zh: 将晚全新世干旱化/洪水减弱单一决定论地解释为印度河去城市化主因，属多因学术模型中的争议读法；Giosan 等亦拒斥单因决定论。
statement.en: Treating late-Holocene aridification / declining floods as the single deterministic cause of Indus deurbanization is a contested reading within multi-causal models; Giosan et al. also reject single-cause determinism.

disclaimer: This record is a HYPOTHESIS / contested scholarly reading, not an established archaeological conclusion. Do not treat as fact.
